intro.answerFirst: Antwerp's best frites, ranging from budget-friendly to gourmet, are a culinary highlight, with Frituur t'Stad standing out as a top recommendation for its authentic, classic experience. To truly savor the best, venture beyond the tourist hotspots and discover where the locals indulge in this Belgian staple. Antwerp, like all of Belgium, is renowned for its frites, but the quality can vary greatly between frituurs (fry shops).
body: Antwerp's best frites, ranging in price from budget-friendly to gourmet, are a must-try for any visitor, with Frituur t'Stad being a top recommendation for its classic, authentic experience. To find the best, skip the tourist traps and head to where the locals go for a truly delicious taste of Belgium.

Antwerp, like all of Belgium, runs on frites. But not all frituurs (fry shops) are created equal. The perfect Belgian frites are a work of art: double-fried for a crispy exterior and a fluffy interior, served in a paper cone with a generous dollop of sauce. Many spots are tourist traps selling mediocre fries. So where do the locals go?

We dug through Reddit threads and local food blogs to find the frituurs that Antwerpenaars and seasoned travelers consistently recommend. Forget the tourist traps — these are the places for an authentic, delicious frites experience.

picks.name: Frituur t'Stad
picks.whyItMadeTheList: Your go-to spot for a perfect, no-nonsense Belgian frites experience in the heart of the old town. It’s reliable, delicious, and ideally located for a snack while sightseeing. A top-tier classic.

picks.name: Frites Atelier
picks.whyItMadeTheList: The most controversial frites in Antwerp. It's not a traditional frituur, and some locals dismiss it. However, the quality is undeniable. If you're looking for an elevated, chef-driven take on frites with creative toppings, this is your spot. Be prepared for lines.

picks.name: Fritkot Max
picks.whyItMadeTheList: A true piece of Antwerp history. Fritkot Max claims to be one of the oldest frituurs in Belgium, and it feels like it in the best way. It’s the perfect, authentic alternative to the more tourist-focused spots, serving top-quality frites from a historic spot on the Groenplaats.

The consistent, glowing reviews from locals say it all.
